gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-bitter: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 stands tall through the middle of every line, its curves left wide open. Bitter, a slab-serif with a huge lowercase eye, carries long reading in a grounded, dependable way.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans keeps every stroke uniform, its c ends flaring apart. Next to Baloo Bhaijaan 2, which stands tall and open, that unvarying line is the quality that defines the pair.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-inter: Tall, open, unmistakable. Baloo Bhaijaan 2 leads, and Inter, a sans with a smooth tube-like line and generous counters, keeps long reading going without a snag.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-mulish: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 has a tall middle band and open curves. Mulish counters with strokes of constant width, like bent pipe, so the heading's weight and the text's simplicity share a page easily.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-poppins: Big, tall, wide-open curves up top. Baloo Bhaijaan 2 carries the personality while Poppins, with no hairlines anywhere and sturdy lowercase, settles into the text beneath it.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-roboto-slab: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 builds a tall central band with open curves everywhere. Roboto Slab, a slab-serif with a dominant middle zone, brings precision and structure that make the pair feel purposeful.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-rubik: Rubik's lowercase looks big beside its capitals, soft and clear. Under Baloo Bhaijaan 2, its open round letters keep a longer stretch of text easy to follow, even at small sizes.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads crisp and modern, with c ends pointing apart. Under Baloo Bhaina 2, its constant pen width lets a longer passage flow smoothly without any visual fuss.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-inter: Baloo Bhaina 2 spreads the terminals of its s wide and sits tall on a high x-height. Inter follows with a smooth, tube-like line and big counters, so a longer stretch reads without friction.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-mulish: Wide-set terminals on the s give Baloo Bhaina 2 its bold, distinctive stamp. Mulish, a plain sans with no thick-and-thin modulation, is the pair's strongest quality: it stays friendly and unfussy.
